info.title: Agent Protocol
info.description: Agent Protocol v0.1.6 plus Runkite platform extensions. Path parameter names in this document use snake_case (e.g. {agent_id}); Go net/http mux uses camelCase (e.g. {agentID}). Wire paths are identical.

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: A run is an invocation of an agent, optionally, on a thread. If applied to a thread, it updates the state of the thread. Otherwise, it has not state or memory persistence.

tags.name: Threads
tags.description:
A thread contains the accumulated outputs of a group of runs. It is a container to maintain the state of an agent across multiple runs. It also acts as a registry for the runs.

A thread keeps track of agent states at every step so that continuity of the context is preserved. Moreover, such a book-keeping enables us some granular controls like debugging, interrupting or replaying a run/invocation.

A thread state is a data context defined by the developer and can be anything (e.g. a `typeddict`) and it gets passed through from one invocation to another so that business logic is instrumented by data.

A thread keeps track of the whole state history. At every step, it also applies a checkpoint, which is primarily a `uuid`, so that it is easier to refer to a chunk of the history.

One can easily query the last state, a specific state (by checkpoint id), the whole state history, or, a part of the history (from a checkpoint).

See `Thread`, `ThreadState` and `Checkpoint` models below for more info.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: An agent is an LLM-powered actor that can be invoked on a thread.

tags.name: Background Runs
tags.description: Background runs are runs that do not run synchronously during the request that created them. They can be managed, cancelled, streamed and waited with these endpoints.

tags.name: Streaming
tags.description: Thread-scoped streaming endpoints for filtered event streams, command delivery, and WebSocket transport.

tags.name: Store
tags.description: Store is an API for managing persistent key-value store (long-term memory) that is available from any thread.

tags.name: Registry

capabilities.title: Agent Capabilities
capabilities.description: Describes which protocol features the agent supports. In addition to the standard capabilities (prefixed with ap.), implementations can declare custom capabilities, named in reverse domain notation (eg. com.example.some.capability).

ap.io.messages.title: Messages
ap.io.messages.description: Whether the agent supports Messages as input/output/state. If true, the agent uses the `messages` key in threads/runs endpoints.

ap.io.streaming.title: Streaming
ap.io.streaming.description: Whether the agent supports streaming output.

input_schema.title: Input Schema
input_schema.description: The schema for the agent input. In JSON Schema format.

output_schema.title: Output Schema
output_schema.description: The schema for the agent output. In JSON Schema format.

state_schema.title: State Schema
state_schema.description: The schema for the agent's internal state. In JSON Schema format.

config_schema.title: Config Schema
config_schema.description: The schema for the agent config. In JSON Schema format.

AgentSchema.title: AgentSchema
AgentSchema.description: Defines the structure and properties of an agent.

StreamingChannel.title: StreamingChannel
StreamingChannel.description: A subscribable streaming channel. Namespaced custom channels use the `custom:*` form.

StreamingNamespace.title: StreamingNamespace
StreamingNamespace.description: Hierarchical path identifying a position in the agent tree. The empty array identifies the root agent.

channels.description: Channels to include in this event stream.

namespaces.description: Namespace prefixes to include. Omit to receive matching events from all namespaces.

depth.description: Maximum depth below each namespace prefix.

since.description: Replay buffered matching events after this monotonic sequence number, then switch to live delivery.

EventStreamRequest.title: EventStreamRequest
EventStreamRequest.description: Request body for a connection-scoped SSE event stream.

id.description: Client-assigned command ID used to correlate the command response.

method.description: Streaming protocol command method, such as `run.start`, `subscription.subscribe`, `input.respond`, or `state.get`.

params.description: Command parameters. Shape depends on the command method.

StreamingCommand.title: StreamingCommand
StreamingCommand.description: Client-to-server command in the streaming protocol.

id.description: ID of the command this response belongs to.

result.description: Command result. Shape depends on the command method.

appliedThroughSeq.description: Latest event sequence number applied before this response.

id.description: ID of the command this response belongs to, or null if the command could not be correlated.

StreamingCommandResponse.title: StreamingCommandResponse
StreamingCommandResponse.description: Server response to a streaming protocol command.

eventId.description: Unique event ID used for reconnection. Maps to the SSE `id:` field.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number for ordering and replay.

method.description: Event method. Most events use the channel name, while some event families use a more specific method such as `input.requested`.

params.description: Event parameters, including namespace, timestamp, and channel-specific data.

StreamingEvent.title: StreamingEvent
StreamingEvent.description: Server-to-client event in the streaming protocol.

RunStatus.title: Status
RunStatus.description: The status of the run. One of 'pending', 'error', 'success', 'timeout', 'interrupted'.

values.title: Values
values.description: The values returned by the run.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The messages returned by the run.

thread_id.title: Thread Id
thread_id.description: The ID of the thread to run. If not provided, creates a stateless run. 'thread_id' is ignored unless Threads stage is implemented.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The agent ID to run. If not provided will use the default agent for this service. 'agent_id' is ignored unless Agents stage is implemented.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The messages to pass an input to the agent.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Metadata to assign to the run.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description: Webhook to call after run finishes.

on_completion.title: On Completion
on_completion.description: Whether to delete or keep the thread when run completes. Must be one of 'delete' or 'keep'. Defaults to 'delete' when thread_id not provided, otherwise 'keep'.

on_disconnect.title: On Disconnect
on_disconnect.description: The disconnect mode to use. Must be one of 'cancel' or 'continue'.

if_not_exists.title: If Not Exists
if_not_exists.description: How to handle missing thread. Must be either 'reject' (raise error if missing), or 'create' (create new thread).

run_id.description: Client-supplied run ID for idempotent creation.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: The time the run was created.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: The last time the run was updated.

parent_run_id.description: Parent run in an A2A delegation chain.

thread_id.title: Thread Id
thread_id.description: The ID of the thread to filter on.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to filter on.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: The time the thread was created.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: The last time the thread was updated.

values.title: Values
values.description: The current state of the thread.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The current Messages of the thread. If messages are contained in Thread.values, implementations should remove them from values when returning messages. When this key isn't present it means the thread/agent doesn't support messages.

ThreadCheckpoint.title: ThreadCheckpoint
ThreadCheckpoint.description: Structured identifier for a thread checkpoint, ie. an entry in the thread's history.

values.title: Values
values.description: The current state of the thread.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The current messages of the thread. This key isn't present for agents that don't support messages.

thread_id.title: Thread Id
thread_id.description: The ID of the thread. If not provided, a random UUID will be generated.

if_exists.title: If Exists
if_exists.description: How to handle duplicate creation. Must be either 'raise' (raise error if duplicate), or 'do_nothing' (return existing thread).

ThreadStatus.title: Status
ThreadStatus.description: The status of the thread. One of 'idle', 'busy', 'interrupted', 'error'.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: The identifier of the checkpoint to branch from. Ignored for metadata-only patches. If not provided, defaults to the latest checkpoint.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Metadata to merge with existing thread metadata.

values.title: Values
values.description: Values to merge with existing thread values.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Messages to combine with current thread messages.

if_match_version.title: If Match Version
if_match_version.description: Optimistic concurrency: update only if the thread's current version equals this value.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: A list of strings representing the namespace path.

key.title: Key
key.description: The unique identifier for the item within the namespace.

value.title: Value
value.description: A dictionary containing the item's data.

StorePutRequest.title: StorePutRequest
StorePutRequest.description: Request to store or update an item.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: A list of strings representing the namespace path.

key.title: Key
key.description: The unique identifier for the item.

namespace_prefix.title: Namespace Prefix
namespace_prefix.description: List of strings representing the namespace prefix.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Optional dictionary of key-value pairs to filter results.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default is 10).

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Number of items to skip before returning results (default is 0).

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Optional list of strings representing the prefix to filter namespaces.

suffix.title: Suffix
suffix.description: Optional list of strings representing the suffix to filter namespaces.

max_depth.title: Max Depth
max_depth.description: Optional integer specifying the maximum depth of namespaces to return.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of namespaces to return (default is 100).

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Number of namespaces to skip before returning results (default is 0).

namespace.description: The namespace of the item. A namespace is analogous to a document's directory.

key.description: The unique identifier of the item within its namespace. In general, keys needn't be globally unique.

value.description: The value stored in the item. This is the document itself.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the item was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the item was last updated.

Item.description: Represents a single document or data entry in the graph's Store. Items are used to store cross-thread memories.

code.description: For some errors that could be handled programmatically, a short string indicating the error code reported.

message.description: A human-readable short description of the error.

metadata.description: A dictionary of additional information about the error.

AgentVersion.title: AgentVersion
AgentVersion.description: One immutable snapshot of an agent definition at a specific version.
